name: S. C. Hopkins Woodworking
old_description: Discover an exquisite collection of finely crafted furniture and one-of-a-kind home accents, each piece created with precision and care. These exceptional designs are made to elevate the comfort of your living space, transforming it into a welcoming and stylish haven.
about:
Based in Honey Brook, Pennsylvania, S. C. Hopkins Woodworking creates custom furniture and one-of-a-kind home accents. The company operates a workshop where each piece is built to order, though its founding year and ownership details are not publicly disclosed.

The shop produces made-to-order furniture such as tables, chairs, and case goods, along with smaller artisan home goods like cutting boards, boxes, and decorative items. A personalized commission service allows clients to collaborate directly on design, dimensions, and wood selection. No facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are published.

The business serves residential customers and interior designers seeking tailored pieces for private homes. Its website emphasizes practical household furniture and unique accents for everyday living spaces.

The company highlights precision and care in every build, positioning its work as a way to elevate the comfort and style of a living space. The personalized commission model is presented as the primary differentiator, enabling one-of-a-kind results that reflect each client's personal taste.
